cohort: The study included singleton and twin clinical pregnancies conceived after fresh embryo transfers, comparing those from preimplantation genetic diagnosis (n=89) with matched intracytoplasmic sperm injection pregnancies (n=166).
finding: No association was found between PGD-conceived pregnancies and risks of adverse neonatal or obstetrical outcomes compared to ICSI pregnancies, except for a higher rate of low birth weight in ICSI twin pregnancies in the meta-analysis.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500g) and mean birth weight.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth and preterm deliveries (<37 weeks).
